samples.question: The ringed emblem is the starting champion. Read the four detached cards by their purple dot counts: one, then two, three, and four. Circle defeats triangle, triangle defeats square, and square defeats circle. At each card, the shown challenger replaces the champion only when it defeats the current champion; otherwise the champion stays. Which emblem is champion after all four cards: circle, triangle, or square?
